description: issue #864: the four Interaction & Events block-heads in VALUE position, with the profile ACTIVE. `spec/grammar.md:390` -- `A keyword in a position none of these cover has no derivation at all and is a parse error, never a silently accepted name: repeat key [ ] does not read as a call to a procedure named key.` The source is the issue's own reproduction, extended with a call argument and an assignment right-hand side so a fix that handled only the `repeat` count cannot pass, and all four names are asserted in one program so a fix that closed only the name a single fixture happened to pick cannot pass either. Its byte-identical twin `block-heads-ordinary-names-core-only` runs these exact bytes with Core Language alone, where the same six positions report `ol-unknown-command` instead: `when` is then an ordinary name nothing declares, not a word in the wrong position. Only the two together pin the rule as PROFILE-GATED -- either fixture alone is satisfied by an implementation that rejects these words in every position or by one that never rejects them at all. Deliberately declares nothing: whether a program may DECLARE one of these names is a different question, answered unconditionally (`spec/grammar.md:408`) and pinned by its own fixtures. Keeping the two questions in separate sources is what stops a change to one from silently moving the other. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.
